name: Naturalización por Domicilio no menor a Veinte Años

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 20 years of domicile in Costa Rica. Unlike cr_naturalisation_residence, formal residence (migratory) status is explicitly NOT required to qualify -- long-standing de facto presence is sufficient.
requirements.fix_path: Establish 20 years of domicile in Costa Rica.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing the Ministry of Public Education's Spanish-language and Social Studies/civics exams, unless exempt (elderly applicants, or permanent health/cognitive conditions with medical certification).
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Spanish/Social Studies naturalisation exams.

evidence_required.document: Two sworn witness statements (residency period, means of support, good conduct)
Spanish/Social Studies exam pass certificate (or exemption)

sources.title: Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (tse.go.cr) -- Naturalización por Domicilio no menor de Veinte Años en Costa Rica, Ley 1902

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build -- kept SEPARATE from cr_naturalisation_residence deliberately, since the source states directly: 'No es necesario que tenga Residencia Oficial (estatus migratorio)' (it is not necessary to have official residence/migratory status). This is a materially different eligibility gate -- it exists specifically for people who have lived in Costa Rica for two decades WITHOUT ever holding formal legal residence, a real population this dataset should not silently collapse into the standard, status-holding-based naturalisation route. Processing: 285 business days, free of charge.
